conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (The lights are back. And the flight attendant… she looks totally normal.)

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (But those faces… that pain… it all felt too real. I can still feel it. Can something like that really be just a dream?)

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: Calm down. First thing I need to do is figure out what’s going on.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: I should talk to the people around me. Right—and jot down what I remember in my notebook first.
